guard: one SELECT, allowed tables, max 500 rows. Checks: dates
and today, "this year" = the financial year, names and rankings,
a name in the question that matches nothing?
plain words + checked facts. Then the answer check: amounts,
percents (never x100), the stock report date - a wrong answer is

question, SQL, answer, status, tokens, time per step, which

14. The API sends "done" with the answer card
the last line of the stream
live steps, the answer word by word, sources, SQL, rows, which
16. React draws the chart the AI chose
kind + the columns to draw; CHART: none -> the table first;
The AI models, in order: Groq gpt-oss-120b (key 1) -> the same model on the second Groq key -> the qwen backup.
A per-minute limit -> the other key at once; a daily limit -> that key rests; an admin's choice -> only that model.
The AI writes the SQL and every answer; our code gives it facts and checks the result. The SQL guard and the read-only login can never be skipped.
